item.title: Will Eagles QB Jalen Hurts have yet another position coach in 2026?
item.description: Reports indicating that the Eagles are interviewing QB coach candidates suggest Scott Loeffler is out after one season and Jalen Hurts is poised for yet another new position coach.

item.title: Cooper Health's new mobile unit brings primary care to people with autism and other developmental disabilities
item.description: Cooper University Health's new mobile unit provides care to people with autism, cerebral palsy or Down syndrome in their homes. It aims to reduce the stress of medical visits for these people and to remove barriers to care.

item.title: ‘Jeopardy!’ fans can test their knowledge at a weekly bar league in Center City
item.description: For those who consider “Jeopardy!” a nightly competition rather than passive viewing, a weekly bar league in Center City moves the game off the couch.

item.title: Gov. Josh Shapiro is again pushing for Pa. to legalize marijuana, but advocates say it's a long shot in 2026
item.description: Pennsylvania Gov. Josh Shapiro called on the state legislature to send him a bill to legalize marijuana during his annual budget address Tuesday. Cannabis advocates believe it could be a long shot again in 2026, but they see some reasons for optimism in Harrisburg.

item.title: City taps into work program to pay over 200 people to assist in snow removal
item.description: As Philadelphia continues to grapple with the aftermath of Winter Storm Fern, the city is tapping into the Same Day Work and Pay program to bring in paid workers to clear snow and ice from the streets, sidewalks and curbs.

item.title: WATCH: Instant reaction to Jared McCain trade as Sixers gain financial flexibility ahead of trade deadline
item.description: Jared McCain's Sixers tenure is over far earlier than anyone would have anticipated. What happens now?

item.title: Philadelphia Museum of Art reverts to old name, but will keep griffin logo from rebrand
item.description: The Philadelphia Museum of Art is going back to its old name, abandoning the Philadelphia Art Museum rebrand less than four months after making the change. The museum will keep the new logo of a griffin that it adopted when the changes were revealed in October

item.title: Jeff Stoutland announces he'll no longer coach the Eagles' offensive line
item.description: Philadelphia Eagles offensive line coach Jeff Stoutland announced on Wednesday night that his "time coaching with the Eagles has come to an end."

item.title: Philadelphia police search for man linked to fatal shootings of 2 tow truck drivers
item.description: Philadelphia police are seeking the public's help to find a man who's allegedly linked to two separate fatal shootings involving tow truck drivers. Najee Williams, 27, faces multiple charges including murder.

item.title: Joel Embiid questionable for Sixers-Lakers on Thursday
item.description: Just hours after the 2026 NBA Trade Deadline passes, the Sixers and Lakers will face off in Los Angeles. What is Joel Embiid's status?
